Comedian Sam Tripoli joins Danny Jones to warn that the full Epstein files would shake the country to its base. The episode title puts his claim in strong words: the real files will destroy society. Tripoli mixes comedy with dark research.

Tripoli lays out what he thinks the unreleased files hold and who he thinks they would expose. Jones lets him build the case at full length, then asks what proof can be shown. The talk ranges over power, blackmail, and why so much stays sealed. The library holds the episode as an archive record, and listeners can judge the claims on their own.
podcast-dannyjones-LG6WC3AdUHM:
Joe Redner, Tampa's famous strip club owner, joins Danny Jones for episode 37 of the KONCRETE podcast. Redner built an empire of neon in Florida and fought city hall for decades over free speech. His clubs and his court battles made him a local legend.

Redner tells the story of his fights under the First Amendment, which he treats as a personal creed. He recounts arrests, lawsuits, and the politics of vice in a Southern city. Jones asks what keeps him fighting after so many years. Bold and free-minded listeners get a Florida original in full voice.
the-works-of-max-beerbohm: Max Beerbohm's essays, stories, and parodies gathered in one volume: the complete wit at his most elegant. From "Enoch Soames" to his savage parodies, it shows the most elegant English stylist of his age. Essential for lovers of irony.
